description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kolinjadiya, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District Case. No. (24/55057)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including specific parcel numbers, land extents, cadastral details, and the legal process for claiming rights to properties under the Registration of Title Act. It falls under the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land ownership, title registration, and property claims rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
